Team —

I'm proposing a condensed calendar for the upcoming annual review window to reduce interruption to Q3 launches while still keeping required calibration gates. High-level ask: please review the attached calendar and the exception workflow PDF and confirm by EOD Monday whether we: (a) accept the proposed staggered submission deadlines by org, and (b) approve the exception triage path for sensitive roles.

Key points in the draft:
- Manager self-assessments open: Aug 10–Aug 24 (two-week window)
- Calibration week (managers only, no hires/ICs scheduled): Aug 31–Sep 4
- Final ratings locked: Sep 10 (global)
- Quiet exceptions: separate submission form + can request private routing to HR for senior ICs / legal-sensitive roles

Open questions for approvals:
1) Do we need a second calibration slot for EU/APAC to account for public holidays?
2) Is the exception flow (page 2 of PDF) legally reviewed or do we need Legal sign-off before rolling to managers?
3) Any changes required for payroll timing if final ratings shift into mid-September?

Attachments: review_calendar_draft.xlsx, exception_flow_v1.pdf

If you can't review the files, let me know and I can surface a one-pager with only the decision items.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Director, People Operations

Thanks Priyom — quick read through the calendar and the exception flow. A few notes inline: 

> Manager self-assessments open: Aug 10–Aug 24 (two-week window)
- OK but can we add a hard reminder on Aug 17 for teams with >25 people? Those managers need longer to compile consolidated comments.

> Calibration week (managers only, no hires/ICs scheduled): Aug 31–Sep 4
- Prefer to keep this but suggest a second, shorter block Sep 7 (2 days) for timezone stagger.

> Final ratings locked: Sep 10 (global)
- If we push a small subset (EU engineering) into Sep 13 because of local holidays, that's acceptable as long as payroll cutoff isn't affected.

Exception flow: page 2 looks good. Legal sign-off: I think we can ship the flow as a pilot to managers and require Legal sign-off only if an exception is escalated. That will speed rollout.

I'll mark these comments in the spreadsheet and add a row for the reminder cadence.

-Lauren

Thanks for the note and the attachments. Short answers:
